statement: Automated checks run by scripts/build_project_site.py before the pages were written, then repeated against the written pages. A failing check aborts the build.

checks.name: source_link_per_row
checks.detail: every estimate, benchmark, provider, technical finding, source and flag row carries at least one source link; a provider row with a website carries two

checks.name: cslb_link_on_every_provider
checks.detail: every provider row links to its official CSLB licence-detail page as its first source

checks.name: no_out_of_scope_content
checks.detail: scanned the data files for 15 phrases that would indicate private or off-record material: 0 hits

checks.name: redirect_targets
checks.detail: every retired-brief redirect page points at a page that exists in this build

checks.name: internal_links
checks.detail: every relative href/src in every written page resolves to a file in the repository

checks.redirect_check: checked 51 redirect pages across 7 retired directories
